text:
Sasha: Kicking off chi-edge1 bring-up. First h100 batch boots but gpu-operator DS is CrashLoopBackOff on most nodes. Pods fail with device open errors. @Liam can you look?
Liam: Oncall here, ping me. paste `kubectl describe ds/gpu-operator -n gpu` and `kubectl logs` of one pod.
Sasha: Here's trimmed log:
```
E0423 12:05:11 gpu_operator.go:87] failed to load kernel modules: modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.10.0-rt
...
error: failed to open /dev/nvidia0: No such file or directory
```
Liam: Hm kernel mismatch. Which AMI did bootstrap use? tag=redwood-gpu-ami-2026-chi-edge?
Anya: We saw this last month — AMI bake accidentally picked kernel-rt variant (5.10-rt). Driver rpm expects generic 5.15. Check `/etc/os-release` and driver package. Also noticed kubelet logs showing cni IPAM errors: ENI prefixlen/eni tag mismatches causing many nodes with no usable IPs.
Sasha: Confirmed AMI is `redwood-gpu-ami-chi-2026-03-18` and kernel is 5.10.0-rt. Driver package in bootstrap script is driver-545.0 which requires >=5.15.
Diego: ALSO seeing cluster DNS flip: nodes resolv.conf points DNS to 10.100.0.53 (legacy resolver) instead of 10.200.0.53 for chi-edge1 due to terraform variable `cluster_dns_zone = "global"` being unset in this env. That caused controller-manager to resolve image registries to private IPs in other VPC and timeouts during init.
Sasha: TL;DR: three simultaneous issues: kernel-driver mismatch -> gpu pods fail; ENI prefixlen misconfig -> ip exhaustion at scale; clusterDNS mismatch -> image pull failures/timeouts.
Liam: Short fixes: 1) patch bootstrap to install driver 535 (compatible) and node reboot; 2) update `aws_vpc_ipv4_assignment_prefixlen` from 28 -> 26 and reapply ipam; 3) fix terraform var `cluster_dns_zone` to chi-edge1 and roll kubeadm config.
Anya: I can push hotfix for AMI bake to pin generic kernel, but safer to pin driver to 535 on existing nodes and roll next bakes.
infra-bot: deploy-canary failed: canary-group-chi-edge1: 8/10 nodes healthy -> failing due to gpu-operator crash
Sasha: I applied driver 535 via user-data hook to the first 10 nodes, rebooted, gpu pods are `Running` on those. ipam change needs planning (will require drained nodes to reassign ENIs).
Diego: For handoff: I'm creating runbook PR and will set a canary window. Also opened cost note: changing prefixlen increases VPC address usage — potential monthly cost for NAT scaling; tag as finance-review.
Sasha: OK handing off to Diego + Anya for bake + tfvar patches. I'll keep monitoring canary and post a summary to #incidents once stable. :thumbsup:
